replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I find mathematics intimidating and challenging. I prefer subjects like economics and literature where I can think more creatively. Math feels dry and overwhelming, especially physics. I try to avoid it when possible, but when I have to, I use simple methods and hope it works out without too much stress or confusion.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. Math makes me nervous, especially when I see complex formulas. I worry about making mistakes or not understanding. My anxiety spikes during exams or when I have to calculate something quickly. I prefer to focus on things that feel more natural to me, like reading or talking about ideas instead of crunching numbers.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor a few months ago. It helped me understand basic concepts, but I felt overwhelmed by the technical explanations. Sometimes it gave me the answer without showing enough steps. Overall, it was helpful but not as engaging as I wanted. I’d rather have a person explain things more simply.
